All Department Leads: Beaconwood Site, 2:00-2:30 PM, Auditorium B"},{"spec_id":"spec_0647","text":"INTERVIEW DEBRIEF: Senior Associate candidate (Atlas rollout team)
Blueford Advisory | Thurs 3:00-3:30 | Room 4 / dial-in in the invite
Organizer: Carmen
Attendees: Quinn Yilmaz, Chidi Thorne, Zoe Xu

Purpose: Get our heads together on the candidate.

1. Housekeeping & coffee (5 min)
Grab a cup, settle in. I'll give a quick lay of the land on where hiring stands for Atlas. Short version: we've still got two seats to fill and the client's breathing down our necks a bit.

2. Round the table: first impressions (10 min)
Each of you gets a few minutes to tell us how your session went. Quinn had the case, Chidi had the behavioral round, Zoe did the culture chat. If you've already filled in your scorecard (and bless you if you have), you can just read from it.

3. Recap of the Atlas rollout staffing plan (5 min)
The same slide you've all seen in the last two staffing calls, for anyone who wants a refresher.

4. Hire / no hire (5 min)
The actual question. Thumbs up, thumbs down, or "let's see one more."

5. Next steps & any other business (5 min)
Who calls the candidate, who calls the recruiter, that kind of thing.

Notes: Please have your scorecards in by Wednesday night if you can manage it. I'll pull them into one sheet so we're not squinting at four different docs. Holler if the time doesn't work and we'll wiggle it.

Thanks, y'all,
Carmen"},{"spec_id":"spec_0648","text":"Project Echo brainstorm (round 3, since rounds 1-2 didn't stick): ideas, then actually decide"},{"spec_id":"spec_0649","text":"FOXCREST BUILDERS
